meaning: The time spent chatting at the table after a meal is over
example: Después de comer, nos quedamos de sobremesa.
translation: After eating, we stayed chatting at the table.

meaning: The small hours of the night; from midnight until dawn
translation: I woke up in the small hours.

meaning: To use or wear something for the very first time
translation: Today I'm wearing new shoes for the first time.

meaning: I hope so; if only
translation: I hope the weather is nice tomorrow.

meaning: Sickly sweet; also someone overly clingy or cheesy
translation: This cake is far too sickly sweet.

meaning: Someone who always feels cold
translation: I always feel cold in winter.

meaning: An afternoon snack around 5 or 6 pm
translation: Do you want something for an afternoon snack?

meaning: A social gathering to chat and debate; often at a café
translation: We have a chat get-together every Friday.

meaning: Shame or embarrassment
translation: How embarrassing!

meaning: Affection; also a sweet way to say "dear" or "honey"
translation: Thanks, sweetheart.

meaning: Excited hope and anticipation for something to come
translation: I'm really looking forward to seeing you.

meaning: A casual beach bar serving food and drinks
example: Comimos en un chiringuito de la playa.
translation: We ate at a beach bar.

meaning: An afternoon nap; especially after lunch
translation: After lunch, a nap.

meaning: Laziness; that "I can't be bothered" feeling
translation: I can't be bothered to go out today.

meaning: To make the most of something; to take advantage of
example: Hay que aprovechar el buen tiempo.
translation: We should make the most of the good weather.

meaning: A hug
translation: Give me a hug.

meaning: Okay; sure. Used constantly in Spain
translation: Shall we meet at eight? Okay.

meaning: Cool; awesome. Casual Spain slang
translation: How cool!

meaning: To lose sleep; to stay awake when you wish you weren't
example: Me desvelé pensando en el viaje.
translation: I couldn't sleep thinking about the trip.

meaning: To daydream; literally "to be in the clouds"
translation: Sorry, I was daydreaming.

meaning: To tease or kid someone; literally "to take the hair"
translation: You're pulling my leg!

meaning: To miss someone or something
translation: I miss you.

meaning: I love you. The everyday one; "te amo" is more intense
translation: I love you a lot.

meaning: Brother-in-law; also the know-it-all relative at family dinners
translation: My brother-in-law knows everything.

meaning: Congratulations
translation: Congratulations on the new job!

meaning: To address someone informally with "tú"
translation: You can use the informal "tú" with me.

meaning: To put up with; to hold out
translation: I can't stand the heat anymore.

meaning: Sunset; dusk
example: Vimos el atardecer desde la playa.
translation: We watched the sunset from the beach.

meaning: Sunrise; dawn
translation: We got up at dawn.

meaning: Umbrella; literally "for waters"
translation: Don't forget the umbrella.

meaning: Butterfly
example: Una mariposa se posó en la flor.
translation: A butterfly landed on the flower.

meaning: You're welcome
translation: Thank you. You're welcome.

meaning: Star
example: Esta noche se ven muchas estrellas.
translation: You can see lots of stars tonight.

meaning: To usually do something: "suelo correr" = I usually run
translation: I usually have toast for breakfast.

meaning: To arrange to meet up: "quedamos a las ocho"
translation: Let's meet at eight.

meaning: Cute; also the word for monkey
translation: What a cute hat!

meaning: A cheeky rascal; literally "without shame"
translation: You're a cheeky rascal!

meaning: To be annoying or nag; literally "to give the can"
example: No me des más la lata.
translation: Stop nagging me.

meaning: To have a good time
translation: We had a great time.

meaning: A pork chop; also an exam cheat sheet
example: Me comí una chuleta con patatas.
translation: I ate a chop with potatoes.

meaning: To wake up very early
translation: Tomorrow I have to get up early.

meaning: To get your act together; literally "to put in the batteries"
translation: We need to get our act together.

meaning: Dachshund; literally "sausage dog"
example: Mi perro salchicha es muy gracioso.
translation: My dachshund is very funny.

meaning: Bridge; also a long weekend made by taking the day between a holiday and the weekend off
example: Este fin de semana hay puente.
translation: This weekend is a long weekend.
